view: PA (frontal) chest radiograph; "L" marker at image upper right confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate. Good inspiration (approx. 9-10 posterior ribs visible), trachea midline, medial clavicle ends roughly symmetric about the spinous processes (minimal rotation). Penetration adequate with thoracic spine faintly visible through the cardiac silhouette. Both costophrenic angles and lung apices included. Lung markings look somewhat coarse/busy, which may partly reflect image processing.

devices.location: Image upper-right corner, projected over the patient's left shoulder / axillary soft tissue, outside the lung field

devices.type: Round radiopaque disc (~1.5 cm) external marker/artifact adjacent to the L marker
devices.location: Just below the L marker, over the patient's left shoulder / humeral head region, outside the lung field
Image far-left edge, upper portion (patient's right side), outside the thorax

abnormalities.finding: Mildly prominent / coarse bronchovascular markings, symmetric, without focal consolidation, nodule, effusion or pneumothorax; most likely technique/processing-related and of doubtful significance

description_zh: 胸部正面（PA）X光片，影像右上角可見「L」側別標記及一鄰近之圓形不透光外部標記物，投影於左肩部軟組織，肺野外。氣管位於中線，心臟大小及縱膈輪廓正常，雙側橫膈平滑且肋膈角銳利，未見肋膜積液或氣胸。雙肺野透亮度對稱，支氣管血管紋理略顯粗糙但呈對稱分布，未見局部實質化、結節或腫塊；骨性胸廓未見明顯異常。整體而言無急性心肺異常，未見任何導管、引流管或治療後的證據。
